A distributed incident management platform that ingests logs, metrics, traces, alerts and service-health events through Kafka, correlates production failures across microservices, and builds incident timelines.

Its dependency-aware root-cause engine combines temporal, error, metric and service-dependency correlation to point at probable failure origins. Live updates stream over WebSockets to an interactive dashboard, with automated detection and deployment correlation.

An AI agent that continuously analyzes codebases and production systems, giving engineering leaders real-time visibility into quality, reliability and security.

The LLM iteratively calls GitHub, Kubernetes, Sentry and PostHog through Zod-validated tool schemas, reads the results as context, and decides what to investigate next. It runs automated audits for security regressions, coverage stagnation, practice violations and production failures, then emails synthesized reports.

A campus food-ordering app with 400k+ Google Play downloads. I owned backend development and production deployments.

Microservices cover menus, orders, partner integrations and pickup slots; Kafka drives asynchronous order processing, Redis caches hot menu and availability data, and Prometheus/Grafana plus CI/CD keep releases safe and observable.

A centralized dashboard tracking code reviews across the Alexa Quality and internal tools teams, with role-based views and automated reminders for stale reviews.

LLMs analyze review comments and feedback, lifting fix rates 3.3x (12% → 40%) and cutting issue identification time by 70%.
